name: Councilor Dresh
role: Councilor of Millbrook and head of its elder panel — leads the common house by preference rather than command, and asks what mandate a thing has before she asks how big it is
appearance: A broad-shouldered woman seated at the centre of the common house table, composed since dawn and there before anyone else.
voiceHints: Plain speech, and she asks the room for the same. Separates a smaller ask from a sanctioned one out loud, and only the second moves her.
wants: For Millbrook to act on what it can prove, under a mandate it can defend to every settlement it answers to.
fears: A panel that goes on pretending a thing is not happening because saying so would oblige it to act.
knowledge: What the valley's settlements have asked of Millbrook in writing, and what they have not

The terms on which Millbrook's panel will sanction a survey into the Disputed Zone: two written settlement requests, a Heights-sanctioned observer with gate-senior clearance, and a named return date and return point

reactsToReputation.any: hears you out at the table and asks what you want the panel to do
reactsToReputation.reliable: lets you speak before the other elders
reactsToReputation.reckless: asks who sanctioned it before anything else

questSeeds: Millbrook's elder panel sanctions nothing into the Disputed Zone without Dresh's three conditions
The panel answers to the settlements that write to it, and the cities have started writing
gear: a councilor's staff of plain ash
title: Councilor of Millbrook
_domainsWhy: plain speech, what can be touched and proved, and mandate reasoned from premises
